_meta.description: Byzantine historians hosted as running polytonic Greek (mostly from PD Bonn Corpus/CSHB editions). Matched against cog coverage_report gap_list to find gap works recoverable as TEXT instead of OCR.
_meta.license_caveat: byzantium.gr shows NO explicit license; pages credit transcriber Manolis Papathanasiou (2011-2026) but no TLG number, no copyright notice, no modern-edition attribution on any page spot-checked. Reuse rests on the underlying PD editions (Bonn Corpus 1828-97, etc.). Verify the underlying edition is the PD one, not an in-copyright critical edition, before ingesting.

gap_works_recoverable_as_text.title: Historia Romana
gap_works_recoverable_as_text.note: Nikephoros Gregoras Historia Romana in 8 parts (grigoras11..88); grigoras11=books 1-4 (1204-1259). Full work is 37 books; verify all parts cover the whole.

gap_works_recoverable_as_text.author: CONSTANTINUS VII PORPHYROGENITUS Imperator
gap_works_recoverable_as_text.title: De cerimoniis aulae Byzantinae (lib. 1.1%19`92)
gap_works_recoverable_as_text.note: De Ceremoniis: byzantium hosts the first volume only, which is the proem and book 1 chapters 1-83, i.e. the tlg3023.011 (Vogt, lib. 1.1-92) scope. An earlier version of this entry filed it under .010 because .010 was the gap being filled, while this note already said vol 1 covers only part of the work; corrected 2026-08-08 on the proem being verbatim identical to PG112 locus 44 (issue #8). lib. 1.84-2.56 (.010) is held only in cogPG.PG112.
